svg.title: Ravi Rajjak — Sugarbox Networks engineering showcase
svg.desc: Senior Software Engineer at Sugarbox Networks (2019-2020). Offline-first edge CDN OTT streaming platform and Feast Plus restaurant order management system.

g.text: Hyperlocal Content Delivery Network & Edge Compute OTT
Architected offline-first media streaming from micro-edge servers & restaurant POS systems.
Architected & built offline-first OTT streaming platform from scratch.
Streamed content directly from local edge servers without cellular data
Optimized playback performance for Android phones & Android TV.
Hardware decoder tuning · High-speed caching · Low-latency ExoPlayer pipelines
Owned architecture & delivery of full-scale restaurant POS system.
Feast Plus: QR table ordering · Kitchen routing · Digital payments & billing
Offline-First OTT · Edge Compute · ExoPlayer · TV
Sugarbox App · Feast Plus POS · TV Player Engine
